auto_switch.description: Deprecated. phc2sys has no -A option. Use -a for automatic clock switching. If set, template still emits -A (no-op or error). Not recommended.

clock_identity.description: Deprecated. phc2sys does not accept a clock identity (-c is reserved for sink device). This directive was hallucinated.

clock_servo.description: Clock servo type: 'pi', 'linreg', 'ntpshm', 'nullf', or 'refclock_sock'. Default is 'pi'. Required for parity with manpage.

dest_clock.description: Destination (time sink) clock — device path, interface, or name. Default is 'CLOCK_REALTIME'. Use -c in phc2sys; previously named 'dest_clock' in template.

domain.description: PTP domain number (0–127). If omitted, defaults to 0. Corresponds to -n in phc2sys.

first_step_threshold.description: Step threshold applied only on the first update (20µs by default). Not currently in schema — added as required by docs.

freq_limit.description: Maximum allowed frequency offset (ppb) for sanity check. When exceeded, warning is logged and servo reset. Default is 200000000 (20%). Set to 0 to disable. Previously named 'freq_range' — corrected to 'freq_limit'.

kernel_leap.description: If true, let the kernel apply leap seconds (default). If false, let phc2sys correct the one-second offset via frequency adjustment (unless step_threshold applies). Maps to -x (no value).

log_level.description: Syslog verbosity level (0–7). Default is 6 (LOG_INFO). Maps to -l.

ntpshm_segment.description: SHM segment number for ntpshm servo. Default 0.

offset_samples.description: Number of PHC readings per sink update. Only the fastest reading is used. Default is 5. Previously named 'offset_samples' — preserved, maps to -N.

phc_device.description: Path to the PHC device (e.g., '/dev/ptp0'). When provided, overrides automatic detection. Corresponds to -s (source device) in manual mode.

phc_timestamping.description: Deprecated. phc2sys does not have a -T option for timestamping mode. This directive was hallucinated.

pi_integral_const.description: Integral constant for PI servo. Default 0.3.

pi_proportional_const.description: Proportional constant for PI servo. Default 0.7.

slave_only.description: Deprecated. phc2sys has no -S flag (it exists but is for step_threshold, not slave mode). Use ptp4l for slave-only behavior.

source_clock.description: Source clock — device path (e.g., '/dev/ptp0'), interface (e.g., 'eth0'), or name (e.g., 'CLOCK_REALTIME'). Required for manual mode.

step_threshold.description: Maximum offset (seconds) before a clock step is allowed. The clock is stepped on start regardless if offset > 20µs unless -F (first_step_threshold) is used. Default is 0.0 (disabled stepping after start).

test_mode.description: If true, run in test mode — compute offsets but do not adjust the clock. Maps to -n domain-number, but due to conflict, template uses -n only when domain is set. To avoid conflict, test_mode should be handled separately or removed. Per manpage, -n has no test-mode function — only domain-number. Thus test_mode is unsupported and should be removed or reinterpreted. For clarity, set default false and note limitation.

transport.description: Deprecated. phc2sys does not accept -x for transport type. That flag exists but controls leap second handling, not transport.

update_rate.description: Sink update rate (per second) in direct mode. Default is 1. Maps to -R.
